answer: Review is staged: a contested decision escalates to a wider, freshly drawn jury, and whoever filed the losing appeal forfeits a deposit proportional to the panel size, which prices misconduct instead of merely detecting it. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. Name the plume stake, the prism escalation, and the timber fresh panel: a farm can pay a plume once, but every prism and every timber it must also buy, and the price compounds. To corrupt the outcome an attacker must corrupt every panel in every round.
